name: get_extraction_candidates
description: Identify functions in a file that are good candidates for extraction to a shared module. A candidate must have high cyclomatic complexity (doing a lot) AND be called from multiple other files (already implicitly shared). Results are ranked by score = complexity × caller_file_count. Requires re-indexing with jcodemunch-mcp >= 1.16 to populate complexity data.

repo.description: Repository identifier (owner/repo or just repo name)

file_path.description: Relative file path within the repo (e.g. 'src/utils.py').

min_callers.description: Minimum number of distinct caller files (default 2).
